name: Social Sciences Building
provenance: UC San Diego Facilities floor plans, converted for the classroom explorer. Rooms are scaled from their official areas and fitted to the campus-map footprint. Rooms 103, 106 and 139 are traced from the public first-floor FIS raster dated 2019-04-23; the original rooms and upper floors are preserved.

sources.scale: Similarity registration to two existing rooms; room areas independently checked.
notes: Room boundaries are manually traced and simplified; small columns and door recesses are omitted.
Registration uses two existing rooms and two independent holdout corners. It preserves the existing local meter frame; no new campus registration is asserted.
The published FIS raster can lag current CAD or room inventory. Its printed revision is 2019-04-23, not the acquisition date.
The floor remains a partial model. Three additional local floor patches follow the recovered room footprints; they do not claim a complete floor outline.
